A_native_verified.control_requirement: Complete native S initialization/Q/M, AAPL H, Nasdaq h, global W and proven shared ordering domain
A_native_verified.segment_rules: Preserve parent protocol native control contract
A_native_verified.normalizer_reuse: only if training record set and content identity unchanged

calendar.buffer_basis: Predeclared engineering choice, not empirically optimized or a guarantee against auctions/halts

B_calendar_observed_research.old_training_source: Intersection with existing native-valid segments only; never readmit invalid native rows
B_calendar_observed_research.new_source_required: Accepted MBO engineering provenance plus corresponding status and locked enum semantics

state.ordinary_resume: After any negative/unknown/conflict block, later group must have TRADING as its only distinct phase update and all records Y/Y; repeated identical TRADING allowed; new segment
state.operational_or_marketwide_event: Quarantine rest of day; generic TRADING cannot release
state.provider_coverage_unknown: Residual limitation only if specifically approved; never verified

ordering.book_order: Original provider/native message order; never reorder by ts_event
ordering.each_status_timestamp: Cut segment and reject every MBO row with equal ts_event, including repeated status
ordering.same_timestamp_controls: Aggregate without order assumptions; contradictory/unknown/negative state blocks
ordering.resume_condition: ts_event strictly greater than boundary and unambiguous eligible state

flags.engineering_rows_flags_1_16: Unverified gate placeholders only when exact accepted adapter provenance is bound

B_calendar_observed_research.normalization: Independent five-TRAIN unique eligible record mean/population std; zero std=1; no tuning/comparison/final records; reuse only on identical set/content
B_calendar_observed_research.control_evidence_difference: Old native training gate is stronger than new observed-status research gate even with identical calendar

required: Positive ordered prices and legal sizes
Complete native groups and snapshot boundaries
shared_quality.known_bad_book_gap_or_reset: Reject/cut; no sample from reset/snapshot; new accepted book and fresh window required
shared_quality.native_old_boundaries: Honor already accepted strict segments; never join across rejected rows

samples.trigger: Every target visible-book mutation, including unchanged top ten
samples.footprint_requirement: All original consecutive records same day/instrument/accepted segment; no compression of invalid records
samples.label: Integer future ask1+bid1 versus current ask1+bid1, no smoothing, zero threshold

access_and_comparison.any_required_date_missing_or_zero_window: block; do not silently drop or reassign
access_and_comparison.old_model_normalizer: Keep TCN01 original bound two-day normalizer
access_and_comparison.fair_tuning_comparison: Same selected endpoint set on December 15-16; do not attribute screening and date changes solely to more training days

pending_acceptance: User review/adoption of specific mode and residual risk
